verdict.rationale: Basecamp's own feature docs state that users can make to-do lists, assign items, set due dates, and create subtasks. This covers creating tasks, assigning them to teammates, and adding due dates, and assignment views reinforce it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth documentation of assignment and due-date behavior beyond marketing copy.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates

citations.quote: Make a list, or ten lists. Assign items, set due dates, attach files, even create subtasks.
you can pop your assignments up without touching the mouse
see who’s on what, even see key dates superimposed over everything
